staticText: JAMB screening calculation worksheet for Nigeria. Normalize UTME from 0-400 to 0-100, then apply only the UTME and Post-UTME weights the user verified from their institution for the current cycle. Weights must total 100%. Never invent or predict institutional formulas, benchmarks, departmental cutoffs, eligibility, or admission chances. Direct programme and subject checks to JAMB IBASS and screening details to the institution's official admission portal.
